summary: Fixed race condition by implementing file-based locking using fcntl.flock. Added atomic_update() method that wraps read-modify-write operations in an exclusive lock.

implementation_details.lock_mechanism: fcntl.flock with LOCK_EX for exclusive access

risks: fcntl.flock is Unix-only; Windows would need different implementation
Lock timeout could cause operations to fail under extreme contention
Orphan lock files could remain if process is forcefully killed (OS cleans up)
